title: Dual-Axis Policy Entailment: A Benchmark for Policy-Change Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.00536v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whether a policy shifts domains and, by extension, continues, broadens, narrows, or reverses previous policy is of paramount importance to the study of public policy. We propose Dual-Axis Policy Entailment (DAPE), which evaluates an ordered pair of policy directives on both dimensions at once: a binary judgment determines whether the two directives govern the same policy domain, and a five-way judgment determines whether the later directive continues, broadens, narrows, or reverses the earlier policy, or governs a different domain altogether. Read together, the two judgments form one five-category label, our primary metric. The two-axis design captures two central dimensions of policy change without conflating errors on either dimension into a generic "irrelevant" label, and it makes annotation more rigorous: a coder cannot dismiss a difficult pair as domain-irrelevant without an explicit, checkable decision. translated_title: 双轴政策蕴含：一个用于政策变化推理的基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.00536v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：一项政策是否发生了领域转变，以及由此延伸的，它是延续、扩大、缩小还是逆转了以往的政策，对公共政策研究而言至关重要。我们提出双轴政策蕴含（DAPE），它在两个维度上同时评估一对有序的政策指令：一个二元判断确定这两条指令是否管辖同一政策领域，一个五分类判断确定后一条指令是延续、扩大、缩小还是逆转了先前政策，或者完全属于不同的政策领域。综合来看，这两个判断构成一个五分类标签，这是我们的主要评估指标。这种双轴设计捕捉了政策变化的两个核心维度，而不会将任一维度上的错误混为一个笼统的“不相关”标签，同时也使标注过程更加严谨：标注员在未做出明确、可核查的判断之前，不能轻易将一对难以判定的政策归为领域无关。我们引入了一个由专家标注的基准……
tldr: 该论文提出双轴政策蕴含（DAPE）基准，通过同时判断政策对是否属于同一政策领域以及后继政策是延续、扩大、缩小还是逆转原有政策，为政策变化推理提供了更严谨、更细致的评测标准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dual-Axis Policy Entailment (DAPE), a benchmark that simultaneously evaluates whether two policy directives govern the same domain and whether the later one continues, broadens, narrows, or reverses the earlier policy, enabling more rigorous reasoning over policy change.
